description: Source code implementing the IPCP (IP Control Protocol) for PPP (Point-to-Point Protocol) in Zephyr OS, including functions for handling IP address configuration, DNS settings, and FSM (Finite State Machine) management.

methods.name: ipcp_handle
methods.description: Handles incoming IPCP packets, passing them to the FSM input function.

methods.name: ipcp_add_address
methods.description: Adds an IP address option to a PPP packet.

methods.name: ipcp_add_ip_address
methods.description: Adds the local IP address to a PPP packet.

methods.name: ipcp_add_dns1
methods.description: Adds the primary DNS address to a PPP packet.

methods.name: ipcp_add_dns2
methods.description: Adds the secondary DNS address to a PPP packet.

methods.name: ipcp_ack_check_address
methods.description: Checks if the acknowledged address matches the expected address.

methods.name: ipcp_ack_ip_address
methods.description: Acknowledges the IP address option.

methods.name: ipcp_ack_dns1
methods.description: Acknowledges the DNS1 address option.

methods.name: ipcp_ack_dns2
methods.description: Acknowledges the DNS2 address option.

methods.name: ipcp_nak_override_address
methods.description: Overrides the address during NAK response.

methods.name: ipcp_nak_ip_address
methods.description: Handles NAK for IP address.

methods.name: ipcp_nak_dns1
methods.description: Handles NAK for DNS1 address.

methods.name: ipcp_nak_dns2
methods.description: Handles NAK for DNS2 address.

methods.name: ipcp_config_info_add
methods.description: Adds configuration info for IPCP.

methods.name: ipcp_dns_address_parse
methods.description: Parses DNS address option from peer.

methods.name: ipcp_ip_address_parse
methods.description: Parses IP address option from peer.

methods.name: ipcp_server_nak_ip_address
methods.description: Sends NAK for IP address during negotiation.

methods.name: ipcp_server_nak_dns1_address
methods.description: Sends NAK for DNS1 address during negotiation.

methods.name: ipcp_server_nak_dns2_address
methods.description: Sends NAK for DNS2 address during negotiation.

methods.name: ipcp_config_info_req
methods.description: Handles configuration request for IPCP.

methods.name: ipcp_set_dns_servers
methods.description: Configures system DNS servers based on IPCP options.

methods.name: ipcp_config_info_nack
methods.description: Handles NACK response for IPCP configuration.

methods.name: ipcp_lower_down
methods.description: Brings IPCP FSM down.

methods.name: ipcp_lower_up
methods.description: Brings IPCP FSM up.

methods.name: ipcp_open
methods.description: Opens IPCP FSM.

methods.name: ipcp_close
methods.description: Closes IPCP FSM.

methods.name: ipcp_up
methods.description: Handles IPCP FSM transition to UP state, assigns IP address.

methods.name: ipcp_down
methods.description: Handles IPCP FSM transition to DOWN state, removes IP address.

methods.name: ipcp_finished
methods.description: Handles completion of IPCP negotiation.

methods.name: ipcp_proto_reject
methods.description: Handles protocol rejection.

methods.name: ipcp_init
methods.description: Initializes IPCP FSM and related settings.
